what: Z3 5.3.1 (WebAssembly build, solved in Node here, in a Web Worker in the browser) against the Python engine (Z3 5.3.0). Verdicts: agree = identical status, holes, margin, violated set; agree_outcome = same outcome, hole values differ because the placement stepped back from the slack centre (it depends on the solver model point) or a hole-box query hit its time limit; equal_optimum = another optimal violated set (same violated weight and margin).

grid.sampling: every valid slot, run in short Node processes (the slots are the label combinations of the 8 curated clips; slots_attempted_reachable_in_the_lab_ui is the subset the Lab page can still reach)
